observations: Photo 0 shows a black engine cover with 'PORSCHE' embossed on the left side and 'EVO' embossed on the right side.
Photo 1 shows a large, multi-cylinder engine with a prominent air intake manifold and a visible alternator.
Photo 2 shows a large engine block with a timing cover and a serpentine belt.
The engines are located in a cluttered workshop or storage area with other car parts.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts

risks.risk: The engine may be a used or rebuilt unit rather than a new original equipment unit (OE).
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with a stamped 'OE' or 'Factory' marking on the block or cover.
risks.if_unproven: as a used or rebuilt engine

risks.risk: The engine may be missing essential components like the crankshaft pulley or timing cover.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with the crankshaft pulley and timing cover installed.
risks.if_unproven: as a missing pulley and cover

risks.risk: The engine may have internal damage such as cracks or blown head gaskets.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine with the crankshaft pulley and timing cover installed.
Photo of the engine block stamped with 'OE' or 'Factory'.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
response.reason: The item is clearly a Porsche engine identifiable by the 'PORSCHE' and 'EVO' markings. It can be priced at its worst case (used/rebuilt) until further proof of authenticity and condition is provided.
